task: Our retrieval-augmented support agent answers 61% of our 400-question internal support set exactly right (last week's run, exact-match grading). Improve it.
Our code-review bot's flags are accepted by reviewers 42% of the time (204 of 486 flags last month). Improve its precision without losing the bugs it catches today.
Three rounds of prompt changes moved our text-to-SQL agent from 54% to 55% execution accuracy on our 300 held-out questions. Progress has stalled. Decide what to try next.
Our single-agent planner solves 31 of 100 multi-step tasks in our internal benchmark. We think the architecture is the limit. Find a better architecture.
Write the analysis of whether our sandbox start latency is good enough and what we should do about it. Last week: p50 4.1 s, p95 11.8 s over 2,000 starts.
Research which approach our coding agent should use for long-session memory. Today it loses earlier decisions after about 150 turns (measured on 40 sessions).
Build an evaluation for our agent that writes pull request descriptions. Today we only have a smoke test, and reviewers rewrite 35% of the descriptions it writes.
Our model judge agrees with human graders on 71% of 300 labeled answers. Make the judge good enough to gate releases.
Redesign the onboarding flow of our developer dashboard. Today 38% of new signups create their first API key within a day.
Polish the run-detail page of our agent console. In 12 recorded sessions users took a median 48 seconds to find why a run failed.
Build an agent app that drafts replies to customer support tickets. Today humans write every reply, taking a median 9 minutes per ticket.
Add an assistant to our product that answers questions over a customer's uploaded PDFs. Our current keyword search answers 44% of a 120-question test set correctly.
Our CI suite takes 38 minutes at the median and fails flakily on 9% of runs. Find out why and fix it.
Cold starts of our serverless API take 2.9 s at p95 (1,400 cold starts last week). Find where the time goes and cut it.
Design the module for billing usage metering. Today usage is computed in four places that disagree by up to 3% on the same customer-month.
Our speech-to-text pipeline has a 14.2% word error rate on our 1,200-utterance call-center test set (last nightly run). Lower it.
Two months of prompt and few-shot changes have kept our invoice field extractor between 87% and 89% of fields correct on 500 labeled invoices. Decide what to try next.
Our coding agent resolves 22 of 75 tasks in our internal bug-fix benchmark with one model in a single loop. We think the loop design is the limit. Find a better agent design.
Our product search scores NDCG@10 of 0.41 on 2,000 judged queries from last quarter. Improve it.
Our call-summary feature has no evaluation beyond spot checks, and support reports that 1 in 8 summaries of long calls omits a customer commitment. Build the evaluation that gates changes to it.
Our nightly data pipeline finished late on 6 of the last 30 nights, missing the 6 a.m. deadline by up to 47 minutes. Find out why and fix it.
Write the analysis of whether our agent's code-execution sandbox should move from containers to microVMs. Container starts take a median 1.9 s, and we had two sandbox-escape findings this year.
Build an agent that triages incoming bug reports with component and severity. Today a person triages them, and 23% of bugs are later reassigned to a different component.
Redesign the plan-upgrade checkout page of our self-serve product. 61% of users who open it leave without upgrading.
Design the module that schedules retries for our webhook deliveries. Retry logic lives in three services today, and 2.4% of webhooks are never delivered.
